messages:
zoe_sales: Heads-up - POC with Carevista: console shows many requests but their Splunk export has empty span arrays for lots of rows. They also hit spikes of 429s during load tests. Can we triage?
nate_se: which exporter are they using (native vs sidecar)? Any sample request/trace ids?
zoe_sales: native exporter to Splunk HEC. sample header they sent: x-request-id: cv-20240901-77. Splunk event exists but "spans": [] inside the JSON.
leo_eng: common causes: 1) sampling suppression; 2) exporter backpressure (HEC 429); 3) header dropped by proxy. Check exporter logs for "http status=429" or "queue full".
nate_se: also check org sampling rate in console. If it's 0.05 we will drop most spans. For POC we can bump to 1.0 briefly.
zoe_sales: customer ran `curl` to HEC and got 200, but exporter logs show intermittent 429s.
leo_eng: that means HEC is accepting low-volume but throttling bursts. Recommend: increase EXPORT_BUFFER_SIZE and enable disk buffering on exporter; whitelist our egress IPs or raise token quota on their LB; also we can provision a temporary per-org RPS bump to smooth bursts.
support_bot: suggested env snippet:
```
EXPORT_TARGET=splunk
EXPORT_HEC_URL=https://splunk.carevista.com:8088
EXPORT_HEC_TOKEN=<REDACTED>
EXPORT_BUFFER_SIZE=52428800
EXPORT_DISK_BACKUP_DIR=/var/lib/redwood/export
```
zoe_sales: customer accepted a short telemetry absorb for the POC. They also asked if sampling=1.0 affects billing.
nate_se: clarify: inference tokens billed normally; telemetry export/storage may incur extra costs if they keep retention. For short POCs we absorb telemetry ingestion.
leo_eng: I bumped sampling to 1.0 for org carevista for 30m and provisioned routing override: max_rps=1000 for 2h. ops-bot: sampling set and routing override applied by leo_eng at 2024-09-01T09:15Z.
zoe_sales: after changes they reran burst tests: 429s dropped and Splunk shows spans for most requests. There are still occasional span_count=0 for cold-starts (KV warmup).
nate_se: follow-ups: add trace header presence to onboarding checklist, document HEC sizing + exporter buffer KB, and add clearer exporter log lines with org id on queue drops.
leo_eng: I'll open a ticket to include org id in the exporter_queue_full log and emit a metric.
zoe_sales: closing loop with Carevista. Thanks team! :tada:
